distributed.notes: Fribbels substat list: CRIT DMG, CRIT Rate, ATK%, ATK. Rolls chosen with a throwaway proxy script (damage ~ scale stat x (1 + CR x CD) x (1 + DMG%), the 2 fixed rolls per stat, the per-relic cap, simple set and trace stats only, an assumed 635 ATK / 1058 HP light cone), not with Fribbels or the kernel. Treat it as a tie-breaker, not a result. Result: CRIT Rate 12 (cap), CRIT DMG 5, ATK% 4, SPD 3. SPD: 3 rolls. 97 base + 25.032 + 4.6 = 126.63; 2 rolls make 131.23 (under 133.34), 3 make 133.53. SPD arithmetic ignores light cone and team SPD buffs. The cycle-1 two-turn threshold is 133.34 (20000/150); src/engine/breakpoints.test.ts pins 134 as 2 turns and 133 as 1.
